findings.passage: Lastly, I would like to address the multiple layers of security already in place to prevent individuals who are not legally eligible to vote from participating in our elections.
findings.note: Official letter on House Minority Leader letterhead (87th District, Shelby County) to the Secretary of State about the Coordinator of Elections' mailing asking about 14,000 registered voters for proof of citizenship. The letter goes on to list existing safeguards (registration process, identity and residency verification, federal database checks) and questions the need for the extra check. The letter itself is the source; fetched by curl and read as PDF text.
